name: two-player
description: Reach the two-player P1->P2 handoff so the 2P save/restore routines run, and pixel-validate them against MAME.
_grounding: Two credits (coin@400 + coin@440; a 2-player start deducts two BCD credits) then 2 Players Start@520; poke 0xA800=0xF0@660 forces P1's death (the destroyed code the collision sweeps write; precondition ship alive 0xA800==0xFF, true from f632). Game-set handoff at f974: ACTIVE_PLAYER 0xAD32 0->1. P1 still has lives, so the handoff is loseLifeAndHandOver's (0x11ED) and loadActivePlayerContextAndPostRoundHud (0x4C75) copies P2's save block in. startTwoPlayerGame (0x189E) runs at the 2P start, before the compared window; the game-over pass-turn through handPlayOverToOtherPlayer (0x1226) is pass-turn.poke.json's. Deterministic (forced death, era stays 0 -> no entropy).
_reaches: startTwoPlayerGame runs before 'responded' first holds, outside the compared window, so it is not declared; high-score.poke.json declares it. loseLifeAndHandOver is declared by mothership-era4.poke.json.
